datasets.name: hist12
queryLines: SELECT * FROM classic_stable_l0m1dn_catalog.support_command_center.gold_hist_kpi_monthly WHERE month > add_months((SELECT max(month) FROM classic_stable_l0m1dn_catalog.support_command_center.gold_hist_kpi_monthly), -12)

datasets.name: kpi12
queryLines:
SELECT sum(tickets) tickets, sum(avg_csat*tickets)/sum(tickets) csat, sum(sla_met_rate*tickets)/sum(tickets) sla_met_rate,
   sum(repeat_contact_rate*tickets)/sum(tickets) repeat_contact_rate, sum(incidents) incidents, sum(revenue_at_risk_usd) revenue_at_risk_usd,
   sum(avg_signal_to_declare_min*incidents)/sum(CASE WHEN avg_signal_to_declare_min IS NOT NULL THEN incidents END) signal_to_declare_min
   FROM classic_stable_l0m1dn_catalog.support_command_center.gold_hist_kpi_monthly WHERE month > add_months((SELECT max(month) FROM classic_stable_l0m1dn_catalog.support_command_center.gold_hist_kpi_monthly), -12)

datasets.name: yoy_month
datasets.displayName: This year vs last year by month
queryLines:
SELECT region_group, concat(lpad(month(month),2,'0'),' ',date_format(month,'MMM')) month_label,
   CASE WHEN month > add_months((SELECT max(month) FROM classic_stable_l0m1dn_catalog.support_command_center.gold_hist_kpi_monthly),-12) THEN 'Last 12 months' ELSE 'Prior 12 months' END period,
   tickets, avg_csat, sla_met_rate, repeat_contact_rate, avg_signal_to_declare_min, revenue_at_risk_usd
   FROM classic_stable_l0m1dn_catalog.support_command_center.gold_hist_kpi_monthly WHERE month > add_months((SELECT max(month) FROM classic_stable_l0m1dn_catalog.support_command_center.gold_hist_kpi_monthly),-24)

datasets.name: yoy_change
queryLines:
WITH t AS (SELECT CASE WHEN month > add_months((SELECT max(month) FROM classic_stable_l0m1dn_catalog.support_command_center.gold_hist_kpi_monthly),-12) THEN 'cur' ELSE 'prev' END p, sum(tickets) tk,
   sum(avg_csat*tickets)/sum(tickets) csat, sum(sla_met_rate*tickets)/sum(tickets) sla, sum(repeat_contact_rate*tickets)/sum(tickets) rep,
   sum(avg_signal_to_declare_min*incidents)/sum(CASE WHEN avg_signal_to_declare_min IS NOT NULL THEN incidents END) s2d,
   sum(customer_detected_minutes) cdm, sum(revenue_at_risk_usd) rar FROM classic_stable_l0m1dn_catalog.support_command_center.gold_hist_kpi_monthly WHERE month > add_months((SELECT max(month) FROM classic_stable_l0m1dn_catalog.support_command_center.gold_hist_kpi_monthly),-24) GROUP BY 1),
   c AS (SELECT * FROM t WHERE p='cur'), v AS (SELECT * FROM t WHERE p='prev')
   SELECT 'Tickets' metric, (c.tk/v.tk-1) change_pct, c.tk current_12m, v.tk prior_12m FROM c, v
   UNION ALL SELECT 'CSAT', c.csat/v.csat-1, c.csat, v.csat FROM c, v
   UNION ALL SELECT 'SLA met rate', c.sla/v.sla-1, c.sla, v.sla FROM c, v
   UNION ALL SELECT 'Repeat contact rate', c.rep/v.rep-1, c.rep, v.rep FROM c, v
   UNION ALL SELECT 'Signal-to-declare minutes', c.s2d/v.s2d-1, c.s2d, v.s2d FROM c, v
   UNION ALL SELECT 'Customer-Detected minutes', c.cdm/v.cdm-1, c.cdm, v.cdm FROM c, v
   UNION ALL SELECT 'Revenue at risk', c.rar/v.rar-1, c.rar, v.rar FROM c, v

datasets.name: churn12
queryLines: SELECT sum(cancellations) cancellations, sum(cancellations)/sum(active_subscribers) avg_monthly_churn_rate, sum(mrr_lost_usd) mrr_lost_usd

FROM classic_stable_l0m1dn_catalog.support_command_center.gold_hist_churn_monthly WHERE month > add_months((SELECT max(month) FROM classic_stable_l0m1dn_catalog.support_command_center.gold_hist_churn_monthly), -12)

datasets.name: churn_rate_m
queryLines: SELECT month, region_group, tier, sum(cancellations)/sum(active_subscribers) churn_rate FROM classic_stable_l0m1dn_catalog.support_command_center.gold_hist_churn_monthly GROUP BY ALL

datasets.name: churn_reason
queryLines: SELECT month, region_group, tier, reason, n FROM classic_stable_l0m1dn_catalog.support_command_center.gold_hist_churn_monthly
LATERAL VIEW stack(5, 'Price', cancel_price, 'Content', cancel_content, 'Payment failure', cancel_payment_failure, 'Playback / technical', cancel_playback_tech, 'Other', cancel_other) s AS reason, n
